answer: Require every agent identity to pass a timber durability test before it can trade: register a hardware-bound key, lock 500 tokens as a bond, and complete three verified jobs for unrelated principals. A sponsor stakes 200 more tokens that slash if the newcomer misbehaves within 30 days. One fake identity then costs 700 tokens plus a distinct device key and 12 hours of real work, so 1,000 fakes cost 700,000 tokens and 12,000 hours. Like a velvet rope at a vertex where only ticketed guests pass, the gate stays cheap for one honest agent and ruinous for a crowd of copies.
